diffSummary: Replaced Cloudflare R2 signing and cleanup with Supabase private Storage using the server-only SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY.
Preserved browser direct upload through object-scoped signed URLs; the secret key is never returned to the browser.
Preserved 10 MB, JPEG/PNG/WebP, six-per-record, audit, idempotency, and soft-delete rules.
Completion verification now checks Storage info and re-downloads the object to compute the actual SHA-256 digest rather than trusting only browser metadata.
Added a guarded migration for the private bike-ops-media bucket with file-size and MIME restrictions.
Updated attachment UI copy from R2 to Supabase private Storage.
rationale: Use the same zero-cost Supabase project for relational data and private media while maintaining object-level authorization and end-to-end integrity checks.
